text.tspan: Total population living in extreme poverty by world region1990 to 2040
Extreme poverty is defined as living below the International Poverty Line of $3 per day. This data is adjusted for
inflation and differences in living costs between countries. Projections are from the World Bank. From
2027–2030 they are based on growth forecasts from the World Bank and IMF. From 2031, they are based on
Data source: Lakner et al. (2025) (updated using World Bank PIP in March 2026)
